Project/Program Title Customer Positive History - Big Data Platform Duration May 2013 - ongoing Location Phoenix, AZ, USA Operating Systems IBM AIX v6.1, Windows Programming Languages Hadoop, Hive, Java
PROJECT DESCRIPTION :
2013 Chairman's Award for innovation winner to AMEX Big Data capabilities that find new ways to pull insights from data to deliver relevance and value to AMEX merchants and card members. The Customer Positive History moves all current historical Fraud and Credit variables from being calculated in CAS to Big Data platform. These variable roll ups will then be passed back onto CAS (Credit Authorization System) for use in authorization. This project allows for CAS to no longer store records beyond 30 days. Enable better customer insight given Big Data capabilities make significant progress towards POA architecture and overall fraud benefit include 120MM.

Project Title GMS Exposure Management Duration Sep 2012 - April 2013 Location Phoenix, AZ, USA Operating Systems IBM AIX v6.1, Windows Programming Languages Pega Rules Process Commander PRPCv5.5, DB2, Java, Hadoop, Teradata
PROJECT DESCRIPTION :
GMS Exposure Management provides an end to end case management and risk monitoring capability for monitoring the financial stability and exposure of merchants, who have a proprietary contract with the bank. Merchant exposure arises out of non-delivery of goods and services to card members and disputes/returns for which the bank has already made a payment to the merchant. This exposure can be partly or fully mitigated through collaterals which would include pending payments to merchants, holdbacks, and other forms of collateral example lien, letters of credit. Merchant exposure and collateral information was dispersed across various platforms, so it was difficult to estimate and mitigate merchant exposure efficiently. This project aims at improving accuracy and simplifying the existing capabilities for monitoring merchant risk exposure, decision and risk assessment document collection while reducing the overhead costs by removing redundant systems/capabilities.
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :
Jagannath is the Project Manager for this Global Exposure Management
Managed distributed project teams Responsible for project planning, estimation, delivery and change management Managed client relationships Prepared SOA, project charter, project management plan, risk and contingency plan Provided technical leadership to BPM project team on resolving /addressing critical issues, identifying process improvement areas
Project Title QTB (Quote to Bill) 51+ 2012 Duration April 2012 - Sep 2012 Location Owings Mills, MD, USA Operating Systems IBM AIX v6.1, Windows Programming Languages Pega Rules Process Commander PRPCv6.1, Oracle 10g
PROJECT DESCRIPTION :
Quote to Bill and Broker Express projects are part of QTB 51+ market segment program, provides a major US HealthCare client a platform to its partners to sell new business and collect binder payment from its customers. Developed a comprehensive rule based system leveraging Pega Group Sales Process Manager framework, for group enrolment process that includes new features in the prospect creation and quote creation after a competitor analysis for sales and quoting system for payers. This implementation improved the efficiency of the quoting process by bringing down the processing time from 2 days to 10 minutes and reduced manual steps in quote creation from 23 to 8. The user interface with the best user experience designed keeping the external users in mind. of 6 Jagannath Sarkar, PMP®, CSM ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :
Jagannath was the Project Manager and Business Analyst for this engagement
Managed the distributed project team Managed project delivery, builds and releases Managed client relationships Analyzed business processes, identified process improvement areas Developed requirement documents, use cases and mock-ups Prepared project management plan, change management, risk and contingency plan
Project Title Trillium Duration October 2009 - March 2012 Location London, ON, Canada Operating Systems IBM AIX v6.1, Windows Programming Languages PegaRules Process Commander PRPCv5.5, PRPC Smart Dispute framework v5.5, Oracle 10g
PROJECT DESCRIPTION :
Developed a cost effective solution for a major Canadian bank, for processing debit card disputes, where the front office users initiates a claim which will be further processed by back office users. The solution built on Pega Smart Dispute framework involves a dispute lifecycle process from initiation to resolution including reimbursement, chargeback, re-presentment, pre arbitration and arbitration. The BPM implementation reduced average resolution time for disputes routed to back-office; streamlined case processing and enhanced efficiency by increasing card dispute resolution speed by 70%.

Jagannath was the Project Manager and Business Analyst for this engagement

EDUCATION

SUMMARY :
Jagannath has over 13 years of extensive experience in managing large and complex programs and projects, involving multiple geographies, spanning different types of engagements from large application development, application maintenance, and business process re-engineering and distributed systems. He has worked with Fortune 500 Clients in Banking and Financial Service, HealthCare and Logistics Industries in United States and Canada.
He is a PMI certified project manager (PMP), skilled in process improvement, streamlining, optimizing, oversight and control, having experience in handling end to end BPM programs of various scales and complexities, predominantly in PEGA based engagements. He has extensive experience managing all phases of system development including requirements definition, design, construction, testing, implementation and support. He has experience in Enterprise Architecture (TOGAF), Distributed Systems (SOA) and Big Data Platform.
Jagannath is a Certified Scrum Master (CSM), having experience in various SDLC methodologies like Agile, Iterative and Waterfall. He is excellent in client relationship management, with strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
Prior to joining Cognizant, Jagannath worked as a solution architect for Wipro Technologies. of 6 Jagannath Sarkar, PMP®, CSM EMPLOYMENT HISTORY :
